retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast graphic style featuring thick, black marker-drawn icons and lettering set against a vibrant cyan canvas texture.
triggerTerms: thick black marker drawing on cyan
marker stroke illustration with canvas texture
excludeWhen: pastel or muted color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A bold, DIY-inspired aesthetic characterized by heavy black ink strokes that mimic a permanent marker. The composition uses a central hand-drawn circular emblem with radiating arrows, paired with expressive, irregular lettering on a saturated blue-cyan background with a subtle woven canvas texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Black ink elements against a high-saturation cyan field
Hand-drawn, imperfect circles containing simplified facial icons
Radiating directional arrows integrated with circular motifs
Heavy-weight marker lettering balanced by smaller secondary text
coreInvariants: Uniformly thick black marker stroke weight
Visible canvas or fabric texture overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large display text at the top, a central large circular icon, and smaller supporting text at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular emblem with radiating arrows.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow starting from the large header, moving through the central icon, and ending at the bottom right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous cyan negative space surrounding the black graphic elements to maintain high legibility.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with maximum value contrast from the black ink.

letterConstructionRules: Constant stroke width mimicking a broad-tip marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers with simplified, blocky marker strokes
Ellipses rendered as thick square blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large, expressive lowercase display lettering paired with smaller, more rigid uppercase marker text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the interlocking, heavy-weight marker feel of the display text.
Captures the rounded terminals and consistent stroke width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid vibrant cyan background with a subtle, fine-grain canvas texture. In the center, place a hand-drawn black marker icon consisting of two concentric circles with five thick arrows radiating from the left side. Inside the inner circle, draw a simplified face using two 'X' marks for eyes and a curved 'U' for a mouth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom black marker lettering. Place large, interlocking lowercase text at the top. Place smaller, all-caps marker text at the bottom right, followed by three thick square dots.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated cyan?
Are all black lines thick and marker-like?
Is there a visible canvas texture?
Is the lettering hand-drawn rather than a standard font?

mustAchieve: High contrast between black ink and cyan background
Authentic marker-stroke appearance with slight bleeds
Consistent hand-drawn quality across all elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly aligned to a grid
Verify the cyan color is vibrant and not muted
Check that the canvas texture is visible but not distracting
Confirm the marker strokes have rounded, organic ends
recipe.reuseFormula: Vibrant Cyan Background + Canvas Texture + Thick Black Marker Icons + Interlocking Hand-Lettered Display Text
